msContents.summary: This is a palm-leaf manuscript of the Itihāsamsamuccaya. According to the catalogue, it is incomplete.

support.p: Extent and leaf size from catalog entry.

lg.l: yaṃtaṃ hitārtthināṃ prabhāvānat_bhutān_s tathā |
romaśaṃ dharmmatatvajñaṃ paryyapṛchśad yudhiṣṭhiraḥ |
yo rakṣet_ prāṇināṃ rājā bhayārtthaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ |
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yat_ syāt tan me brūhi tapodhana |

ekataḥ kra
s sarvve samastavaradakṣiṇāḥ |
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ |
atraivoraṃtīmam itihāsaṃ purātanaṃ |
indraśysyāgneś ca saṃvādaṃ śibeḥ auśīnarasya ca |
varttamāne mahāyajñe jijñāsārtthaṃ śibin nṛpaṃm |
ndraḥ śyenaḥ kapoto gniḥ bhūtvā tatropajagmatuḥ |
bhayagabalanetraś ca mumaṃ jihvāṃ nivratya ca |
athorupya kapotaḥ śyenajāt_ bhayāt |
śaraṇārtthī mahīpālaṃ vililye bhayavihvalaḥ |

tataḥ śanair upāgamya śye
ūpaḥ sureśvaraḥ |
rājānaṃ sumahātmānaṃ provācedaṃ vacas tadā |
mahārāja kapoto yaṃ vidhātrā vihito mama |
bhakṣyo bubhukṣā mahatī varttate visṛjā |
kapoto yam atitrasyaś śaraṇārtthī samāgataḥ |

tasmā
dharmmo me bhītapālanaṃ |
dharmmātmānaṃ hi tvām āhur ekatrājan mahīkṣitāṃ |
satvadharmmaviruddhaṃ hi kathaṃ karmma cikīrṣasi |
bhavān_ kṛtaghnaṃ dānena satyenānṛtavādinaṃ |

kṣamayā krūrakarmmāṇam asādhuṃ sādhunā
yet |
nopakārapare py evam upakāraparo janaḥ |
apakārapare pi tvam upakaraparo yathā |
ahite tvaṃ hitaḥ pāpe tvam apāpo hi sarvvadā |

doṣānveṣaṇadakṣeva guṇānveṣaṇata
t_paraḥ |
tadeṣa vihito bhakṣyaḥ pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā |
mā hīṃsīr ddharmmalopo na dharmmam ut_sṛjya māvasiḥ |
santrastarūpaḥ prāṇārtthī svatto bhīto vihaṃgamaḥ |

mat_sakāśam anuprāptaḥ prāṇagṛdhnurayaṃ
khagaḥ |
tad evam āgatasyāsya kapotasyābhayārtthinaḥ |
katham asmadvidhas tyāgaṃ kuryyād vyaddha vigarhitaṃ |
lobhād veṣāt_ bhayād vāpi yas tyajet_ śaraṇāgataṃ |
brahmahatyāsamaṃ tasya pāpam āhur mmanīṣiṇaḥ |

śāstreṣu niṣkṛtir ddṛ
ṣṭā mahāpātakinām api |
śaraṇāgatahantus tu na dṛṣṭā niṣkṛtiḥ kvacit |
yathātmanaḥ priyāḥ prāṇaḥ sarvveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā |
tasmān mṛtyubhayatrastās trātavyāḥ prāṇino budhaiḥ |

janmamṛtyujarādu|khaigaḥthai saṃsārasā
gare |
jantavaḥ parikliśyante mṛtyos trasyanti te tataḥ |
yannimitto bhavech śokas trāso vā krodha eva vā |
āyāso vā yato mūlam ekaṃkam api na tyajet |
mariṣyāmīti yad du|khaṃ puruṣasyopajāyate |

jñeyas tenānu
mānena paro pi parirakṣituṃ |
yathā ca te jīvitam ātmanaḥ priyaṃ tathā pareṣām api jīvitaṃ priyaṃ |
saṃrakṣyate jīvitam ātmano tathā yathā pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitaṃ |
tasmāṃ nāham imaṃ bhītam tarpayiṣye kapotakaṃ |
yad atra yuktam manyante karttuṃ śyenāśu tad vada |
āhārāt_ sarvvabhūtāni saṃbhavanti janeśvara |
āhāreṇa vivarddhante tena jīvanti caiva hi |
śakyante duṣkare py artthe cirarātrāya jīvitaṃ |

na tv āhāravihīnasya śakyaṃ varttayituṃ kvaci
t |
bhakṣyād vilopitasyātmā mama prāṇair vviyujyate |
visṛjjya kāyaṃ yāsyānti panthānam apunarbhavaṃ |
mṛte ca mayi sarvvam me putradārā vinaśyati |
rakṣyamāṇaḥ kapotatvaṃ bahūn_ prāṇān_ haniṣyasi |

dharmmaṃ yo bādhate dharmmo
dharmmaḥ parantapa |
avirodhī tu yo dharmmas sa dharmmas sat_bhir ucyate |
tasmād virodhe dharmmasya vicintya gurulāghavau |
yato bhūyās tato rājan_ kuru dharmmavinirṇṇayaṃ |
nāto bhūyastaro dharmmaḥ kaścid anyo sti khe
ṇināṃ bhayabhītānām abhayaṃ yat_ pradīyyate |
varam ekasya satvasya pradattaṃ jīvito bhayaṃ |
na ca viprasahasrebhyo gosahasran dine dine |
abhayaṃ sarvvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayā paraḥ |

tasya dehād vimuktasya
dyate |
hemadhenudhanādīnāṃ dātāras sulabhā bhuvi |
durllabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvvabhūtadayāparaḥ |
sarvveṣām eva yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyyate phalaṃ |
bhītābhayapradānasya kṣaya eva na vidyate |
s taptaṃ tīrtthaṃ vedaśrutan tathā |>
sarvvāṇy abhayadānasya kālan nārhanti ṣoḍaśīṃ |
catussāgaraparyyantāṃ yo dadyāt_ pṛthivīm imāṃ |
abhayaṃ yaṃ yac ca bhūtebhyas tayor abhayado dhikaḥ |

api tyaje rājyam idaṃ śarīraṃ vā saṃ
|
santrastaṃ tyakṣye dīnaṃ kapotakaṃ |
yan mamāsti śubhaṃ kincit_ bhavej janmani janmani |
bhaye trātā bhayārttānān mārttināśāya dehināṃ |
na hy ahaṃ kāmaye rājyaṃ na svargaṃ nāpunarbhavam |
prāṇināṃ dukhataptānāṃ
yathā ca nānṛtāṃ vācam etām udāhare |
satyenānena bhagavān_ prasīdatu maheśvaraḥ |
āhārārtthe samāraṃbhas tava cāyaṃ vihaṃgamaḥ |
tad yatheṣṭaṃ tavāhāram anyad eva dadāmy ahaṃ |

ya eṣa vihito
kṣyaḥ kapotakaḥ |
tam evot_sṛjjya nāhāraiḥ kāryyam asty aparair mmama |
śyenāḥ kapotān_ khādantī śrutir eṣā sanātanī |
mā rājan_ sāratāṃ jñātvā kadaḷīskaṃddham āruha |

nāhaṃ kuśāstramārgeṇa kva
gamaḥ |
śāstrair eva pradiṣṭo yad dharmmas sarvvadayāparaḥ |
sarvvasatveṣu yad dānam ekasatve ca yā dayā |
sarvvasatvapradānāt tu dayā satto viśiṣyate |

sarvve vedā na tat_ kuryyus sarvve yajñāś ca
|
sarvvatīrtthābhiṣekaś ca yat_ kuryyāt_ prāṇinān dayā |
vāṅ_manaḥkarmmabhir yye tu sarvvabhūtahite ratāḥ |
dayādarśitapanthāno brahmalokaṃ vrajanti te |

gachśatas tiṣṭhato vāpi jāgrata svapa
pi vā |
yan na bhūtahitārtthāya tat_ paśor iva ceṣṭitaṃ |
jaṃgamāni ca bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi ca ye narāḥ |
dayayā parirakṣanti te yānti paramāṃ gatiṃ |
prāṇinaṃ vadhyamānan tu yaḥ śaktas samupekṣate |
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoram iti prāhur mmanīṣiṇaḥ |
rājyaṃ śibīnāṃ sumahat_ prayachśāmi tava dvija |
yad vā kāmayase hy anyad varjjayitvā kapotakaṃ |

yadi rājan_ kapote te sudṛḍhā bha
ktir īdṛśī |
tataḥ kapotatulyāni svamāṃsāni prayachśa me |
anugraham imam anye yan māṃ śyenābhiyācate |
etat te haṃ prayachśāmi svamāṃsaṃ yā dhṛtaṃ |

yad avyayaṃ tat_ sujanaś cirād va
dati mānavaḥ |
mama tu priyam evaitat_ kasmān nābhihitaṃ cirāt |
addhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā |
ddhruvaṃ yo nārjayed dharmmaṃ sa śocyo mūḍhacetanāḥ |

yadi prāṇyupakārāya deho yan nopayujya
te |
tataḥ kim upacāro sya pratyahaṃ kriyate mayā |
nātiriktam ahaṃ yāce tava māṃsaṃ janeśvara |
tasmāt_ kapotena samaṃ prayachśa tulayā dhṛtaṃ |
tad evāhaṃ ṣyāmi yan māṃ śyenābhiyāṣase |

yenāsya rakṣa
syāt tad vā tava vihaṃgama |
evam uktvā svamāṃsāni samut_kṛtya sa pārtthivaḥ |
prahṛṣṭas tulayā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ dadau |
tyaktvātmasukhabhogechśāṃ sarvvasatvahitaiṣiṇaḥ |

bhavanti paradu|khena sā
khitāḥ |
ddhrīyamāṇas tu tulayā kapoto vyatricyate |
punaś cot_kṛtya māṃsani tataḥ prādāt_ sa pārtthivaḥ |
na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ kvacit |

tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃso sāv ārūro
āṃ sva |
paradu|khāturā nityaṃ sarvvabhūtahite ratāḥ |
nāpekṣante mahānmānaḥ svasukhāni mahānty api |
atha tasmin_ samārūḍhe tulām auśīnare nṛpa |
devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ca |
tatas tasya tadā matvā dharmme rājña sthitiṃ parāṃ |
śākra svarūpam āsthāya vākyam etad abhāṣata |
indro ham asmi bhadran te kapoto havyavāhanaḥ |
jijñāsamānau tvāṃ rājan imaṃ yajñam upāgatau |

naita
kariṣyanti cāpare |
mahākāruṇikenaiva yat_ kṛtaṃ duṣkaraṃ tvayā |
parārtthe tyajataḥ prāṇānyā prītir abhavat tava |
prāṇasaṃgrahalubdhānāṃ na sā prāneṣu dehināṃ |
parārtthaikā
tvayy eva kevalaṃ rājan_ karu
karmmapāśaiḥ sudṛḍhair baddhaṃ kṛt_snam idaṃ jagat |
dduḥkhamokṣārtthaṃ baddhaḥ karuṇayā nṛpa |

tathā sarvvātmanā cā
prahṛtaṃ tvayā |
yathā caivātmanasthāne vāsanā na viśeṣitā |
akṛtverṣyaṃ viśiṣṭeṣu hīnān anavamarttya ca |
akṛtvā sadṛśai sparddhāṃ tvaṃ lokottamatāṃ gataḥ |

ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇānyo naraḥ pari
ti |
saḥ yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yato nāvarttate punaḥ |
prāṇair api tvayā rājan_ rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇo janaḥ |
svamāṃsāny api dattāni dravyeṣv anyeṣu kā kathā |
paśavo pi hi jīvanti kevalātmodaraṃbharāḥ |

na
jīvati ślāghyo yaḥ parārtthaṃ hi jīvati |
kiṃ cātra citraṃ yat_ santaḥ parānugrahatat_parāḥ |
na hi svadehaśaityārtthaṃ jāyante candanadrumāḥ |
paropakāravyāpāraparo yaḥ puruṣas sadā |
tad avāpnoti parād api hi yat_ padaṃ |
paropakāraikadhiya svasukhe vigataspṛhāḥ |
jagaddhitāya jāyante sādhavas tv ādṛśā bhuvi |
yat te māṃsāni gātrebhyaḥ samuktāni ca pārtthiva |

eṣā te śāśvatī
kīrttir llokān anu gamiṣyati |
divyarūpadharaś caiva pālayitvā ca medinīṃ |
sarvvalokān atikramya brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyati |
evam uktvā tam indrāgnī jagmatus tridaśālayaṃ |

rājā ca kratum iṣṭvāsau mumude
devavac ciraṃ |
ya idaṃ śruṇiyān nityaṃ śibeś caritam uttamaṃ |
sa vidhūyeha pāpāni prayāti tridivaṃ naraḥ |
vicintya rājā svaśarīram addhruvaṃ dhruvaṃ yaśaścas sarvvajanasya |

śarīradānāt_ parajīvarakṣa
ṇaṃ vidhāya lokatrattrayabhūṣaṇaṃ yayau |
